title: Plancherel identity on the sign cube
statement: Let $\iota$ be a finite set and let $f,g:\{\pm1\}^{\iota}\to\mathbb R$. Then $\mathbb E_x[f(x)g(x)]=\sum_{S\subseteq\iota}\widehat f(S)\widehat g(S)$, where $\widehat h(S)=\mathbb E_y[h(y)\prod_{i\in S}y_i]$ and the expectations are uniform over sign assignments.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ and $g$ are real-valued functions on sign assignments
